origin.description: Renames prefixes in place. The URL stays with the old position.
origin.value: d1 and d2 become foo and bar
origin.example: x <- read_xml("<root><doc1 xmlns=\"http://foo.com\"><baz /></doc1><doc2 xmlns=\"http://bar.com\"><baz /></doc2></root>"); paste(capture.output(xml_ns_rename(xml_ns(x), d1 = "foo", d2 = "bar")), collapse = "\n")
